gen-gf-goldman-gf-matangi: Matangi draws its lowercase hefty and its strokes like twine pressed flat, with rounded letters left open beneath Goldman's wide-set heading. Goldman's low-contrast build gives it a surprisingly gentle bite.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-maven-pro: Wide, round and commanding up top. Maven Pro follows with a high-waisted lowercase and no thick-thin shifts, so the two keep one steady line across the page.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-michroma: Goldman spreads out wide with round, parenthesis-like forms and a big lowercase. Michroma then gives each letter its own wide berth, a tall-bodied sans with stubby ascender tips.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-miriam-libre: Goldman's lowercase towers over its capitals, set wide with generous clearance between letters. Miriam Libre holds a wire-like, steady pen pressure, with an s that opens generously at each bend.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Wide, round and a bit stern. Mochiy Pop One brings a very large lowercase eye and constant strokes as if bent from wire, while Goldman keeps the commanding display voice.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Goldman's round forms look like open parentheses, and its lowercase stands tall against the capitals. Mochiy Pop P One would feel heavy if the heading went small, since its sizable lowercase and wide gaps would take over.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline keeps its bowls round and unswelling, with counters that breathe and a lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. Under Goldman's wide, commanding heading it reads steadily.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mozilla-headline: Big-bodied and friendly, with a splayed c terminal. Mozilla Headline sits under Goldman's wide-set, commanding letters, and the two share generous lowercase heights that keep the page feeling full.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text looks bold in its lowercase because the letter bodies are so tall, with terminals that flare outward. Goldman is best at commanding display, while this sans does the quiet carrying.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-nata-sans: Goldman's round forms read like open parentheses, widely set with generous clearance between letters. Nata Sans matches that single-weight drawing with a technical-pen steadiness and wide-mouthed curves.
